arabic text: SANBHAL KAY CHALNA YEH BAZAR E SHAM HAI\nZAINAB\nTHA JIS KA WADA YEH WOHI MAQAM HAI ZAINAB
english translation text: Walk carefully—this is the marketplace of\nShaam, Zainab; this is the very\nplace that had been promised, Zainab.

arabic text: NA JANAY KAUN SEE MANZIL HAI JIS PAY BAY\nCHADAR\nATTHARA PEHRON SAY TERA QAYAM HAI ZAINAB
english translation text: Who knows at which stage,\nwithout a veil, you have\nremained for eighteen watches, Zainab.

arabic text: KHAJOORAIN PHAINKNAY WALON KO KYA NAHIN\nMALOOM\nNABI KI AAL PAY SADQA HARAM HAI ZAINAB
english translation text: Do those who throw dates\nnot know that charity is forbidden\nfor the Prophet's family, Zainab?

arabic text: AJEEB WAQT HAI YEH FATIMA KI BETI PER\nLAEEI'N NEY POOCHA HAI KYA TERA NAAM HAI\nZAINAB
english translation text: What a strange moment for\nFatima's daughter: the accursed one\nasks, 'What is your name?'—Zainab.

arabic text: SAMAATO'N KI NIJASAT PAY MOT TARI HAI\nKHUDA KAY LEHJAY MEIN MEHW E KALAM HAI\nZAINAB
english translation text: Death has fallen upon the impurity\nof their hearing, while she speaks\nin the language of God—Zainab.

arabic text: WOH DASTAN E MUSEEBAT JO KARBALA SAY CHALI\nDAYAR E SHAM MEIN TUJH PER TAMAM HAI ZAINAB
english translation text: The story of calamity that began in Karbala\nreaches its completion upon you in the land of Shaam, Zainab.

arabic text: KARAM HAI MAZHAR E KHASTA JIGAR PAY RAB KA\nBOHOT\nYEH KHUSH NASEEB JO TERA GHULAM HAI ZAINAB
english translation text: It is the Lord's immense grace\nupon broken-hearted "Mazhar" that this fortunate\none is your servant, Zainab.
